SOURCE_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier of the source in the provider's
registry of sources.

SOURCE_KIND.description: What kind of data the source supplies.

ORIGINATOR.description:
Agency, operator or catalog that created the source data, as it names
itself. Not a message's CCSDS ORIGINATOR, which names who created the
message.

PROVIDER_ID.description:
Identifier of the provider that published the product, as the provider
names itself: the module, node or service that retrieved the source data.

PRODUCER.description:
Identifier of the software that made the product from the source data,
with its version when it has one.

LICENSE_CLASS.description: What the source's terms permit for the product.

LICENSE_ID.description:
Identifier of the terms LICENSE_CLASS was read from: an SPDX license
identifier where one applies, else the identifier of the terms in the
provider's licence register.

LINEAGE.description:
Identifier of the lineage the source's data descends from. Sources that
republish one upstream share its lineage, so their products are not
independent of each other.

SOURCE_URL.description:
Replayable URL or provider query identifying the source material as it
was retrieved (the SOURCE_URL of $CMR and $AVL).

SOURCE_VERSION.description:
Source revision, edition or upstream update marker verbatim: for a file
its originator stamps, the stamp.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond time the source material was retrieved.

SOURCE_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the exact source payload bytes as retrieved, 64 lowercase
hexadecimal characters. Empty when the source cannot expose replayable
bytes.

SOURCE_BYTES.description:
Number of source bytes SOURCE_SHA256 covers: the length of the prefix when
the source was fetched by range. 0 when not stated.

CMEMeasurement.description: One analysis of a CME's geometry and speed.

CATALOG.description: Catalog and technique, verbatim (e.g. M2M_CATALOG, SWPC_CAT; CDAW).

IS_MOST_ACCURATE.description: The source marks this analysis as its best.

REFERENCE_TIME.description:
The instant the measurement refers to, RFC 3339 UTC (DONKI time21_5;
CDAW first C2 appearance).

REFERENCE_HEIGHT_RSUN.description: Heliocentric distance of REFERENCE_TIME, solar radii (21.5 for DONKI).

CENTRAL_PA_DEG.description: Plane-of-sky central and measurement position angles, and width, degrees.

SPEED_KM_S.description:
Speeds, km/s: the analysis's speed; CDAW linear, 2nd-order initial,
final and at 20 Rs.

TYPE_CODE.description: Source type token, verbatim (e.g. S, C, O, R, ER).

TARGET.description: Target, verbatim (e.g. Earth, STEREO A, Mars).

MODEL.description: Model, verbatim (e.g. WSA-ENLIL+Cone); empty for an observation.

SOURCE_EVENT_ID.description: Model run or observed-event identity, verbatim.

GLANCING_BLOW.description: True when the source states a glancing blow; meaningful only when HAS_GLANCING_BLOW.

KP_PREDICTED.description: Predicted Kp per assumed IMF clock angle (DONKI kp_18 .. kp_180).

EVENT_ID.description: The source's own identity, verbatim (DONKI activityID; CDAW date-time).

SOURCE_LOCATION.description: Source location token, verbatim (e.g. N12W05), and parsed Stonyhurst.

LINKED_EVENT_IDS.description: Linked event identities as the source states them (flares, shocks, storms).
